text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Hosni Mubarak participates today in the G15 conference in Harare and delivers an opening speech. He receives ministers of India and Algeria and stresses the importance of cooperation. Mubarak's speech is expected to touch on the role of the group of 15 and developing countries in setting up a new world order.
- 64 corpses recovered from the rubble of the collapsed building in Heliopolis while search continues.
- Summit expected to be held between Mubarak and Syria's president soon to discuss the latest developments in the Middle East peace process and other issues.
- In the Middle East economic conference, Egypt is to offer 116 projects with capital of $22.8 billion.
- Palestinian President Yasser Arafat sends Mubarak a letter dealing with the results of talks with the Russian foreign minister.
- Egypt's Foreign Minister Amr Moussa, in Harare for the G15 conference, says that Egypt will participate in 21 projects with Malaysia, Indonesia and other countries.
